resources.string: GPS is recorded only during a walk. OpenStreetMap loads over the internet; the map server receives requests for map areas. Routes stay on your phone and are included in full backups. Without internet the route is saved, but map tiles may be unavailable. GPS may not get a fix indoors. Recording is limited to 24 hours.
